args: for s in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:+${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/mcp-serve.sh}" "${GESTALT_LAUNCHER:-}"; do case "$s" in /*) [ -x "$s" ] || continue; [ "$s" = "${GESTALT_LAUNCHER:-}" ] && echo "gestalt MCP: GESTALT_LAUNCHER override — running $s" >&2; exec "$s" ;; esac; done; exec npx -y @tienne/gestalt@0.72.3 serve
